title: Fix native proof trimmer bugs that forced untrimmed replays
summary: Fixes three bugs in Z3's native proof trimmer (missed conflicts from watches on false literals, assumed empty clauses taken for no conflict, and a crash on div/mod hints without a checker plugin) that sent a third of clause logs of 4 KB and up back to the untrimmed replay. The Lean suite passes and no large random log falls back for these reasons anymore.
